title: [Riso] TAC – Subject Filter – Empty search – No suggestions shown
description: AC 01 — Decision Table — Empty Subject search does not imply a partial catalog.
preconditions: HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce org.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff opens the Subject filter.
steps_result: 1. The Subject search input opens with no subject suggestions.

title: [Riso] TAC – Subject Filter – Matching text – Matching subject selectable
description: AC 01 — Equivalence Partitioning — A matching Subject remains searchable and selectable.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce org.
Subject Mathematics exists.
steps_actions:
1. HQ or CM Staff enters Math in the Subject filter.
2. HQ or CM Staff selects Mathematics.
steps_result:
1. Mathematics is shown as a matching result.
2. The Subject filter shows Mathematics as selected.
